renameOriginalOptionalField_R.description:
Changed value modifier from optional to non-empty. This field is renamed
without proper deprecation.

originalNonEmptyField.description:
This field's declared value modifier changes, but the actual resolved modifier
is unchanged across versions, so it shouldn't be flagged by metrics.

changeInheritedField.description:
This field's declared value modifier changes while the base field stays the
same, so it should be flagged by metrics.
